description: Aggregate occurrence counts across a dimension (COUNTRY, STATE_PROVINCE, YEAR, BASIS_OF_RECORD, DATASET_KEY, KINGDOM_KEY, etc.). Returns one page of facet values ranked by count descending — the top facetLimit at facetOffset 0, a later slice of the same ranking past that. No record payloads returned. Core tool for distribution analysis and trend queries: "which countries have the most records for this species?", "how has observation volume changed since 2010?". Key and GADM dimensions (KINGDOM_KEY through SPECIES_KEY, DATASET_KEY, PUBLISHING_ORG, GADM_LEVEL_0_GID through GADM_LEVEL_3_GID) return bare keys; includeLabels names the taxon, dataset, publishing organization, or administrative area behind each one on the page. Scope the aggregation with taxonKey (or checklistTaxonKey with checklistKey, for a Catalogue of Life key), country (uppercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), publishingCountry, stateProvince, gadmGid, year, scientificName, latitude/longitude ranges, month, hasCoordinate, hasGeospatialIssue, isInCluster, coordinateUncertaintyInMeters, geometry (all spatial filters intersect), basisOfRecord, datasetKey, publishingOrg, catalogNumber, institutionCode, recordedBy, mediaType, typeStatus, establishmentMeans, license, occurrenceStatus, or iucnRedListCategory filters. Also the way to split a result set too large for gbif_search_occurrences to page (offset+limit caps at 100,001): facet by DATASET_KEY, then search each datasetKey on its own. Aggregates sightings only by default, matching gbif_search_occurrences and gbif_count_occurrences; to measure the presence/absence split itself, pass facet OCCURRENCE_STATUS with occurrenceStatus ANY.

basisOfRecord.description: Scope to a specific basis of record.

catalogNumber.description: Catalog number a collection assigned to the specimen or record (e.g. "L.1592880"), matched as the whole value, case-insensitively. Not unique across collections — one number can name records in several datasets, so pair it with institutionCode or datasetKey to single one out. Omit the field to leave it unfiltered — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

checklistKey.description: Taxonomy taxon keys are read in, both in this scope and in KINGDOM_KEY through SPECIES_KEY facet buckets. Omitted, or d7dddbf4-2cf0-4f39-9b2a-bb099caae36c, is the GBIF Backbone, whose integer keys taxonKey takes; GBIF no longer updates it. 7ddf754f-d193-4cc9-b351-99906754a03b is the Catalogue of Life eXtended Release, the taxonomy GBIF now maintains: scope by one of its keys with checklistTaxonKey, which requires this value, and taxonKey is rejected under it. Records keep their Backbone taxonKey either way.

checklistTaxonKey.description: Catalogue of Life taxon key, such as 3WSJV (Lynx pardinus), to scope to that taxon and every descendant — the checklistTaxonKey gbif_match_species or gbif_bulk_match_species returns under the same checklistKey, or a KINGDOM_KEY through SPECIES_KEY bucket of gbif_occurrence_facets under it. Requires checklistKey 7ddf754f-d193-4cc9-b351-99906754a03b, and goes to GBIF as its taxonKey. Uppercase letters and digits only, matched case-sensitively; a digit-only key such as 8288 (the genus Tringa) is not the Backbone taxonKey of the same spelling, which names an unrelated taxon. Omit the field to leave it unfiltered — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Coordinate uncertainty in meters as a range "min,max", both ends inclusive, where "*" may stand for one open end: "0,1000" or "*,1000" keeps records placed to within 1 km. A value without a comma is not an upper bound: GBIF matches only records whose uncertainty is exactly that value, so "1000" is not "within 1 km". Omit the field to accept any uncertainty — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, uppercase, of where the occurrence was recorded, to scope to one country. Not the publisher's country — that is publishingCountry, and the two disagree on most records. Scope to one country, or pass back a value this tool returned under facet COUNTRY to drill into that bucket. Lowercase and alpha-3 forms ("gb", "USA") match nothing upstream, which is why only the uppercase two-letter form is accepted here.

datasetKey.description: Scope the aggregation to a single dataset by its GBIF dataset UUID (8-4-4-4-12 hex). Obtain one from gbif_search_datasets, gbif_get_dataset, a DATASET_KEY facet, or the datasetKey field on an occurrence record. Omit the field to aggregate across every dataset — an empty string is rejected rather than read as no scope, because GBIF answers a blank datasetKey with the unfiltered aggregation.

decimalLatitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84) as a range "min,max", both ends inclusive (e.g. "47.0,48.5"); pair it with a decimalLongitude range for a bounding box. A value without a comma is not a range: GBIF matches only records at exactly that latitude, so "38" is not "around 38". All supplied spatial filters intersect, geometry included. Omit the field to leave latitude unbounded — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

decimalLongitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84) as a range "min,max", both ends inclusive (e.g. "8.0,9.5"); pair it with a decimalLatitude range for a bounding box. A value without a comma is not a range: GBIF matches only records at exactly that longitude, so "-3" is not "around -3". All supplied spatial filters intersect, geometry included. Omit the field to leave longitude unbounded — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

establishmentMeans.description: How the organism came to be where it was recorded — a concept from GBIF's EstablishmentMeans vocabulary: native, nativeEndemic, nativeReintroduced, introduced, introducedAssistedColonisation, uncertain, or vagrant. Matched ignoring case and surrounding whitespace, then sent and echoed in scope in GBIF's own spelling; any other value is rejected. A concept also matches its narrower ones: native covers nativeEndemic and nativeReintroduced, and introduced covers introducedAssistedColonisation. Most records state none and match no value. Omit the field to leave it unfiltered — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

facet.description: Dimension to aggregate by (e.g., COUNTRY, YEAR, BASIS_OF_RECORD, SPECIES_KEY, OCCURRENCE_STATUS, IUCN_RED_LIST_CATEGORY). DATASET_KEY is the first cut when a result set is too large to page: every occurrence carries exactly one datasetKey, so its buckets cover totalOccurrences with no gap or overlap. BASIS_OF_RECORD and PUBLISHING_COUNTRY are gap-free second cuts for a dataset bucket still too large; both have a matching filter on the occurrence tools. A dimension a record can lack drops that record from every bucket: YEAR loses undated records; MONTH, STATE_PROVINCE, SPECIES_KEY, INSTITUTION_CODE, MEDIA_TYPE, RECORDED_BY, TYPE_STATUS, and ESTABLISHMENT_MEANS lose records lacking that dimension; GADM_LEVEL_0_GID, GADM_LEVEL_1_GID, GADM_LEVEL_2_GID, and GADM_LEVEL_3_GID lose records without coordinates or outside every GADM unit at that level — each even where the occurrence tools can filter on it. MEDIA_TYPE and RECORDED_BY buckets also overlap: a record with two media types or two collectors counts in each, so their sums can exceed totalOccurrences. TYPE_STATUS and ESTABLISHMENT_MEANS buckets overlap the same way: a record counts under its concept and every broader one (an Isolectotype also under Lectotype and Type, a nativeReintroduced record also under native). GADM buckets are GIDs to pass back as gadmGid; INSTITUTION_CODE buckets come back lowercased and institutionCode takes them unchanged; RECORDED_BY buckets are the exact spellings recordedBy matches; PUBLISHING_ORG, TYPE_STATUS, ESTABLISHMENT_MEANS, and LICENSE buckets pass back unchanged as publishingOrg, typeStatus, establishmentMeans, and license. OCCURRENCE_STATUS buckets read DETECTED and NOT_DETECTED, the current GBIF names for PRESENT and ABSENT, and pass back unchanged as occurrenceStatus. KINGDOM_KEY through SPECIES_KEY buckets are Backbone keys to pass back as taxonKey. Under checklistKey 7ddf754f-d193-4cc9-b351-99906754a03b they are Catalogue of Life keys to pass back as checklistTaxonKey, some all digits (8288, the genus Tringa) yet never Backbone keys. Sums are comparable only across the same occurrenceStatus scope.

facetLimit.description: Maximum number of facet values to return (default 10, max 100).

facetOffset.description: Zero-based offset into the ranked facet values, for paging past the first facetLimit values on high-cardinality dimensions like DATASET_KEY. Advance by facetLimit to fetch the next page (0, then facetLimit, then 2×facetLimit, …).

gadmGid.description: GADM administrative-area GID at any level: country (ESP), state or province (ESP.1_1), county or district (ESP.1.5_1), or municipality (ESP.1.6.3_1). GBIF derives a record's GIDs from its coordinates, so records without coordinates match none, and the unit can differ from the verbatim stateProvince the record carries. Matched exactly and case-sensitively, and a GID holds only uppercase letters, digits, dots, and underscores — any other character is rejected. Take one from a GADM_LEVEL_0_GID, GADM_LEVEL_1_GID, GADM_LEVEL_2_GID, or GADM_LEVEL_3_GID facet on gbif_occurrence_facets, or from the gadm field of gbif_get_occurrence; a well-formed GID GBIF does not hold matches zero records rather than erroring. Omit the field to leave it unfiltered — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

geometry.description: WKT polygon to scope the aggregation to a geographic area (e.g., POLYGON((8 47, 9 47, 9 48, 8 48, 8 47))). Coordinates are longitude latitude. All supplied spatial filters intersect: decimalLatitude and decimalLongitude remain active and restrict results to the overlap. Omit the field to aggregate everywhere — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered aggregation.

hasCoordinate.description: True includes records with coordinates; false only records without coordinates. Omit for both.

hasGeospatialIssue.description: True keeps only records GBIF flagged with a spatial issue when interpreting them — zero coordinates, coordinates out of range, or coordinates outside the stated country, for example; false keeps only records with no such flag. GBIF often drops the coordinates of a flagged record, and a record without coordinates can carry either value, so for records to map pair false with hasCoordinate true. Omit for both.

includeLabels.description: True names what each bucket on the returned page identifies with a label: the canonicalName for a KINGDOM_KEY, PHYLUM_KEY, CLASS_KEY, ORDER_KEY, FAMILY_KEY, GENUS_KEY, or SPECIES_KEY bucket, read from the Catalogue of Life when checklistKey selects it and from the Backbone otherwise; the dataset title for a DATASET_KEY bucket; the organization title for a PUBLISHING_ORG bucket; the administrative area's name for a GADM_LEVEL_0_GID, GADM_LEVEL_1_GID, GADM_LEVEL_2_GID, or GADM_LEVEL_3_GID bucket. Costs one extra GBIF request per bucket, up to facetLimit, all bounded by one 10 s deadline; a bucket whose lookup fails, finds no name, or misses the deadline comes back without a label and is counted in notice. The other dimensions are codes or values that read as they are, and it looks nothing up for them. Leave it false when keys are enough, as when partitioning by DATASET_KEY.

institutionCode.description: Code of the institution holding the record (e.g. "K", "CLO"), matched as the whole value, case-insensitively — part of a code or of a multi-word code matches nothing. An INSTITUTION_CODE facet on gbif_occurrence_facets lists the codes in a scope, lowercased, and this filter takes them unchanged. Omit the field to leave it unfiltered — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

isInCluster.description: True includes likely duplicates; false excludes them. Omit to include all records. GBIF exposes membership only, with no cluster identifier.

iucnRedListCategory.description: Scope to records whose taxon carries this IUCN Red List category: CR Critically Endangered, EN Endangered, VU Vulnerable, NT Near Threatened, LC Least Concern, DD Data Deficient, EX Extinct, EW Extinct in the Wild, CD Conservation Dependent. Leave unset and facet on IUCN_RED_LIST_CATEGORY to see the whole distribution instead.

license.description: License the record is published under, as its GBIF code: CC0_1_0, CC_BY_4_0, or CC_BY_NC_4_0 — every record carries one of the three. A record states its license as a Creative Commons URL instead (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode for CC_BY_4_0), which this filter does not take.

mediaType.description: Only records carrying at least one media item of this type: StillImage (photographs, scans), MovingImage (video), Sound (audio), or InteractiveResource. Records without media are excluded when this is set.

month.description: Calendar month (1–12), matching the occurrence search filter.

occurrenceStatus.description: Presence/absence scope. Defaults to PRESENT so the aggregation counts sightings, not the surveys that looked and found nothing, and agrees with gbif_count_occurrences on the same filters. Use ANY for both — required to see both buckets when facet is OCCURRENCE_STATUS — or ABSENT for non-observations alone. DETECTED and NOT_DETECTED, the spelling records and OCCURRENCE_STATUS buckets carry, select the same records as PRESENT and ABSENT and are sent as given.

publishingCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, uppercase, of the organization that published the record — not where the occurrence was observed, which is country. Scope to one publisher country, or pass back a value this tool returned under facet PUBLISHING_COUNTRY to drill into that bucket. Lowercase and alpha-3 forms ("us", "USA") match nothing upstream, which is why only the uppercase two-letter form is accepted here.

publishingOrg.description: UUID (8-4-4-4-12 hex) of the GBIF organization that published the records, to scope to what it shares across all its datasets — not the organization whose installation hosts them, and not publishingCountry. Take one from gbif_search_publishers, the publishingOrganizationKey of gbif_get_dataset, a gbif_search_datasets row, gbif_get_occurrence, or a gbif_search_occurrences row, or a PUBLISHING_ORG facet on gbif_occurrence_facets; a well-formed key GBIF does not hold matches zero records. Omit the field to leave it unfiltered — an empty string is rejected rather than read as no filter, because GBIF answers a blank publishingOrg with the unfiltered scope.

recordedBy.description: Collector or observer, matched against each name in the record's recordedBy list (GBIF splits it on "|") exactly and case-sensitively: "Charles Darwin" and "charles darwin" differ, and one person written two ways ("Charles Darwin", "Darwin, C.") is two values. Take a value from a RECORDED_BY facet on gbif_occurrence_facets scoped the same way and pass it back unchanged; an unmatched value matches zero records rather than erroring. Omit the field to leave it unfiltered — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

scientificName.description: Scientific name, which GBIF resolves to its accepted taxon, so a synonym scopes the records of that taxon; a name shared across kingdoms, such as Oenanthe (a bird genus and a plant genus), matches nothing — use taxonKey from gbif_match_species with kingdom set for one. With taxonKey GBIF takes their union (OR), not their intersection. Omit to leave names unfiltered; blank or whitespace-only is rejected.

stateProvince.description: State, province, or first-level administrative division, matched as a verbatim string — exact and case-sensitive. Pass back a value this tool returned under facet STATE_PROVINCE rather than a guessed one: GBIF stores what each dataset recorded without normalizing it, so "England", "England - Greater London", and "Greater London" are three distinct values, "england" is none of them, and an unmatched value aggregates zero records rather than erroring. Omit the field to aggregate across every state or province — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered aggregation.

taxonKey.description: Backbone taxon key to scope the aggregation. Matches the given taxon and all descendant taxa (subspecies, varieties, etc.). Rejected under checklistKey 7ddf754f-d193-4cc9-b351-99906754a03b — scope by a Catalogue of Life key with checklistTaxonKey there.

typeStatus.description: Nomenclatural type status of a specimen — a concept from GBIF's TypeStatus vocabulary such as Holotype, Isotype, Lectotype, Paratype, Syntype, Neotype, Type, or NotAType. Matched ignoring case and surrounding whitespace, then sent and echoed in scope in GBIF's own spelling; a value naming no concept is rejected with the full list. A concept also matches every narrower one — Type covers every kind of type, Lectotype covers Isolectotype — and a TYPE_STATUS facet on gbif_occurrence_facets lists the concepts in a scope. Omit the field to leave it unfiltered — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered scope.

year.description: Year or year range (e.g., "2020,2024") to scope the aggregation. Both endpoints inclusive. Omit the field to aggregate across every year — a blank or whitespace-only value is rejected rather than dropped, because GBIF answers one with the unfiltered aggregation.

name: gbif_occurrence_facets

cap.description: facetLimit applied when the page was capped. Re-call with facetOffset advanced by this value to page on. Absent otherwise.

counts.description: Facet values ranked by count descending — one page of up to facetLimit entries starting at facetOffset, not necessarily the top ones.

items.description: A facet value with its occurrence count.

count.description: Occurrence count for this facet value.

label.description: Name of the taxon (its canonicalName), dataset (its title), publishing organization (its title), or GADM administrative area (its name) the key identifies. Present only with includeLabels on a KINGDOM_KEY through SPECIES_KEY, DATASET_KEY, PUBLISHING_ORG, or GADM_LEVEL_0_GID through GADM_LEVEL_3_GID facet, and only when the lookup for this bucket found a name.

name.description: Facet value (country code, year, basisOfRecord, etc.).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: A string scope filter other than country and publishingCountry was supplied blank or whitespace-only (a blank country or publishingCountry fails earlier, at its uppercase pattern, as -32602 invalid_arguments), decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude, or coordinateUncertaintyInMeters is a bare "*", datasetKey or publishingOrg is not an 8-4-4-4-12 hex UUID, gadmGid holds a character other than an uppercase letter, digit, dot, or underscore, checklistTaxonKey holds a character other than an uppercase letter or digit, taxonKey was supplied under checklistKey 7ddf754f-d193-4cc9-b351-99906754a03b or checklistTaxonKey without it, typeStatus or establishmentMeans names no concept in its GBIF vocabulary, a two-letter country or publishingCountry code is one GBIF does not know, or GBIF rejected another filter as malformed. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

facetOffset.description: Zero-based offset applied to the ranked facet values.

notice.description: Guidance when no facet values were returned, a read limit was clamped, a lookahead bucket proves more remain, includeLabels left buckets without a label, a scientificName or an exact-match stateProvince, gadmGid, or recordedBy filter matched nothing, a decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude, or coordinateUncertaintyInMeters without a comma matched only that exact value, or a presence/absence filter narrowed the aggregation. Absent only when none applies.

occurrenceStatus.description: The presence/absence filter applied upstream, as sent — PRESENT or DETECTED for sightings, ABSENT or NOT_DETECTED for absences, or ANY when no filter was sent. Says what totalOccurrences and every bucket cover.

scope.description: Effective supplied biological filters, with occurrenceStatus always included; excludes pagination and facet controls.

shown.description: Facet values returned in this page when the page was capped. Absent otherwise.

totalOccurrences.description: Total matching occurrences across all facet values.

truncated.description: Present and true only when an extra upstream bucket proves another page exists. Absent on the final page, including an exactly full final page.

title: Occurrence Facet Aggregation
